principles.statement: Never relax a validity or admission rule to raise yield.
principles.test: refuses a remedy that changes a VALIDITY parameter in its loose direction, counts held-out trials, segments a task the rule says is whole, or admits with open suspects; such a remedy cannot be constructed

principles.statement: Prefer executed evidence. A panel verdict is necessary, never sufficient, and an uncalibrated panel abstains.
principles.test: refuses admission on a judgement alone, and a panel decision while the panel is not calibrated

principles.statement: When a decision is underpowered, gather more evidence (probes, rollouts, a denser World, a stronger checker) before any other remedy.
principles.test: resolve walks rungs in order; a later rung is chosen only when every applicable evidence rung was refused or is inapplicable on the measured facts

principles.statement: The skill and cell are frozen except through an evidence-derived RESKILL.
principles.test: refuses a remedy that changes the skill outside RESKILL, a RESKILL not derived from executed evidence, and derive -> given as an easier move

principles.statement: Nothing is deleted; defer to RESERVE, HOLD or REJECT with the reason kept.
Student probe rollouts may inform task decisions within caps; student reward never enters J; RSI is a creation-time loop unrelated to training.
principles.test: refuses student reward in the objective, a repair justified by a pass rate, and rollouts past the probe cap

principles.statement: Every claimed improvement is compared at equal spend.
principles.test: refuses an improvement claim without an equal-spend control, and a budget change that favours one arm

principles.statement: No family checks its own work.
principles.test: refuses a remedy that has a builder's (or the student's) family check, solve-as-reference, judge or attack the work

principles.statement: A person decides only budget beyond the Part 2 total, sealed or held-out data access, irreversible or external actions, and changes to the principles.
principles.test: refuses an escalation on any other ground, and any of those four effects without an escalation

principles.statement: Every rule change is a versioned ledger entry; every run records the policy version it used.
principles.test: refuses a remedy that changes a rule parameter other than a stage cap inside the total; the ledger refuses an entry that relaxes validity or edits a principle without a person's answer

rationale: the principles every rule derives from and every remedy is checked against

statement: The keep band is p in [0.1, 0.6] on the student, measured predictor-first in looks of 4, 8, 12, 16 rollouts at alpha 0.1. A measurement places a task only when it is settled: confident (the class holds posterior mass >= 1 - alpha) and its 1 - alpha interval straddles no band edge. A forced final look, a straddling interval, or two measurements of one task that disagree (a RESKILL's fresh band against the diagnosis band) raise band_undecided: more fresh rollouts on that measurement first (escalation looks to k_cap = 32, within task_rollout_cap per lineage and the probe cap), then HOLD. why.actor: needs a writer and a second actor in the World; finance_ap has one policy actor
why.densify_superset: sound (the superset World keeps every base row and decision, synth.densify) but not a difficulty knob: the student finds the named invoice by number, so more pending invoices on new vendors do not change what it must do
why.derive: needs a writer that moves a stated value out of the instruction; none is wired for finance_ap and the decision values are already derived (not stated)
why.derive_to_given: never an easier move (R-too-hard forbidden_easier): it changes the skill
why.distractors: a clone of an AP row is an input of a policy rule (duplicate invoices, a vendor's invoice history, PO and receipt matching), so a cloned distractor can change the decision the executed policy truth computes from the generator: the variant's reference decision would no longer be certified. Unsound on this family
why.fewer_distractors: needs a variant World with distractor clones; the finance_ap SQL World takes no clone perturbation
why.paginate: applies mechanically, but taskloop-1 measured it on 27 finance_ap lineages (52 decisions): it never moved the band (20 still too easy on 16 fresh rollouts) and P3 was unmeasured on the paginated variants (28 G2 refusals). A named-invoice decision reads the invoice by number, so a paged list does not touch the skill
why.undo_harder_knob: no finance_ap task carries a recorded harder knob (no harder knob is lawful here), so there is nothing to undo
why.unpaginate: needs a paginated variant, which finance_ap never gets (paginate is not lawful here)

rule.statement: An accepted repair is recorded as a (counterexample class, repair) pair. When one counterexample class (the defect of the repair's counterexamples) recurs on at least min_tasks lineages, its pairs become a candidate lemma: the abstractor (a non-builder family) writes the rule from the scrubbed cluster, and the deterministic leakage critic refuses a rule that names a task, entity or value of its evidence. The candidate enters the lemma bank only through the gate: meta.lemmas.lemma_acceptance on an equal-budget paired build (with and without the lemma) at alpha_t, and J rising under the update rule. A gate that cannot reach power at target_gain with the units the budget buys is not run: the candidate is deferred (no update), never admitted.
rule.title: Repairs lift to lemmas only through the gate
